messages:
mira: FYI customer reported invoice tokens are ~2x what's shown in the private dashboard. they run agent v1.8.3 in their VPC and claim no spike in app traffic. asking for urgent triage.
samir: can you paste the invoice lines + dashboard window and the agent hostname? quick checks: agent version, restart history, and whether they enabled force-retry.
mira: invoice excerpt attached in ticket — 2,389,120 tokens billed for 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-11. dashboard (us-east-1, tenant redwood-corp) shows ~1,191,640 tokens same window. host: meterbox-03.internal.redwood
jordan: pinging the onprem agent health API now: `curl -sS http://meterbox-03.internal:9191/agent/meta` returns: `{"version":"1.8.3","uptime":"3d4h","queue_len":0}`
lee: any recent deploys or config changes on customer side? queue_size or retry_count changes could double-count if dedupe fails.
mira: customer says they toggled "persistent-buffering=true" a week ago and bumped `max_offline_retries` from 3 -> 10.
samir: that raises a red flag. if retries cause duplicate deliveries but events don't have stable ids, the collector may attribute duplicates as extra tokens. ask for a short log slice around the restart times.
mira: pasted logs (anonymized):
```
2026-03-10T02:12:03Z INFO agent starting, version=1.8.3
2026-03-10T02:12:05Z WARN connection lost to redwood-collector (code=EPIPE) enqueueing 142 events
2026-03-10T02:12:10Z INFO retrying batch id=none attempt=1 size=142
2026-03-10T02:12:12Z INFO delivery succeeded batch_count=3 events=142
2026-03-10T03:01:01Z INFO flush scheduled prefix_cache_hits=23
```

mira: I redacted event bodies but we have lines showing `batch id=none` — looks like events don't get id assigned on client side in this config.
jordan: exact problem: when agent crashes/reconnects it retried local buffer and re-sent events without idempotency keys. collector treats them as new because metadata (seqid) isn't set. if the collector increments tokens on each arrival, duplicate deliveries would double-count.
lee: do we have evidence of duplicates at the collector side? any repeated event_ids or same request body repeated with different ingestion ids?
meter-agent-bot: alert: ingestion dupe-rate anomaly detected for tenant redwood-corp between 2026-03-10T02:00 and 2026-03-10T04:00. dupe-score=0.72. linked -> https://console.internal/redwood/alerts/ingestion-dupes/9872
samir: good — bot confirms. mira, can you get the collector logs for the same window and grep for repeated payload signatures? use `jq -c .event_body | sha1sum` to fingerprint events (no need to share payloads here).
mira: asked customer for collector logs. meantime, reproducer idea: run a local agent with persistent-buffering true + max_offline_retries 10, simulate brief connection failure, ensure events are generated without client-side event_id and see if collector counts double.
jordan: quick fix proposal: ship a patch to agent that includes client-side event_id UUID v4 for each buffered event and persist the id to disk with the buffer entry. the collector already supports dedupe by client_event_id header if present.
lee: for short-term mitigation for this tenant: can we enable server-side dedupe heuristics (fingerprint-based) for their tenant and credit duplicates retroactively after audit?
samir: yes we can run a dedupe job over suspect window and generate a credit if we can match >=95% duplicates. needs engineering signoff and billing approval.
mira: customer agreed to temporary mitigation if we can show a plan. they want repro steps and ETA.
jordan: I'll open a patch PR for agent (branch: v1.8.4-dedupe-ids) and include tests. ETA for patch + canary: 48 hours. after canary, we push building images for customers.
lee: I'll draft a billing note for credits if post-dedup job finds >20% duplicates. need approval from finance.
meter-agent-bot: ticket created: SUPPORT-5521 linked -> https://tickets.internal/SUPPORT-5521
mira: action items: 1) customer will send collector logs (mira) 2) jordan->PR for agent client_event_id (48h) 3) samir->prepare dedupe job + run on suspected window once logs received 4) lee->billing hold and credit draft. assigning owners.
mira: thanks team — i'll update ticket once I have logs. :pray:
jordan: thanks — will ping once PR is up and include a small migration plan for existing buffers (we'll add id generation on replay of buffer entries).
samir: FYI, long-term we also should validate that agent preserves seqid across restarts when persistent-buffering=true. if seqid resets, we could also add a `buffer_epoch` field to avoid overlap.
lee: noted. we'll track as follow-up in ENG-3267.
mira: closing out here until logs arrive.
